observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a black console with a label reading 'XBOX ONE CONSOLE' and a serial number.
Photo 1 and 2 show the front/top of the same black console with the Xbox logo on the front edge.
A power brick/cable is visible beside the console in photo 2.
No game controller (pad) is visible in any of the three photos.
No power-on screen, HDMI cable, or disc tray open shot is shown.

claims.evidence: Photos show the console's exterior looks free of major dirt or damage, but 'clean' as a condition claim about internals/functionality cannot be confirmed from stills.
No controller/pad appears in any of the 3 photos; only the console and a power brick are shown.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or boot properly
risks.proof: A video or photo of the console powered on showing the Xbox dashboard

risks.risk: Controller claimed but not shown, may not actually be included
risks.proof: A photo of the controller alongside the console, ideally with serial/pairing visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no controller

risks.risk: Disc drive or HDMI port functionality unknown
risks.proof: A clip showing a disc being read or HDMI output on a screen

risks.risk: Power adapter shown may not be the original/matching one or may be faulty
risks.proof: A clear photo of the power brick's label/rating plus a working power-on clip

risks.risk: Internal wear, overheating history, or prior repairs not visible externally
risks.proof: Photos of the underside/vents and any internal shots if opened
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst case cosmetic/functional condition

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the dashboard
Photo of the included controller (pad) next to the console
Clip showing a disc being inserted and read, or app launching
Clear photo of the power brick's rating label
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Xbox One console from the label in photo 0, but no controller is shown despite the seller's claim, and there is no proof of power-on or functional state, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested console without a confirmed pad.
